title: On the global dynamics and blow-up dichotomy for inhomogeneous coupled nonlinear Schrödinger systems
summary: In this work, we investigate the dynamics of an inhomogeneous coupled nonlinear Schrodinger system with quadratic-type interactions. Such systems arise naturally in nonlinear dynamics and mathematical physics, particularly in nonlinear optics, plasma physics, and wave propagation in inhomogeneous dispersive media. We establish a sharp criterion characterizing the dichotomy between global existence and finite-time blow-up of solutions to the associated initial value problem.
